advisor_review_2026_10_16.r5: Implemented in the client's retry wiring (autornd/routing/openrouter.py). The detector (_is_server_disconnect) matches httpx.RemoteProtocolError by type, walking the __cause__/__context__ chain with an id-seen set - never by message text (hard rule 2): the message is prose a serving could echo on any error, and an httpx error of another class is a different failure with its own accounting.
